answer: Verified work alone earns reputation and blocks fakes. A new agent starts at zero weight, gaining standing only from verified jobs, two points per epoch, unbuyable and untransferable. A prism audit splits each job into worker, task, and outcome facets, rejecting reused facets. Growth is glacier slow: ten jobs earn full weight, so the thousandth fake still needs its own ten jobs, or 10,000 jobs for 1,000 fakes at 5 credits each. Work rental fails: proofs bind to one worker key, so rented proof earns weight for its owner only. Honest agents keep full weight from the ocean.
